title: TCP Client
text: Configure TCP client, 1 input, 1 output; {Use host-target connection} uses Ethernet connection between development and target, {Remote server IP address} sets the iP address of the server, {Remote server port} sets the port number of the server, {Use Nagle’s algorithm} enables Nagle, {Client IP address} sets the iP address of the client device that is being configured no and {Client local port} sets the iP port of the client device that is being configured no. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Connect block to remote Ethernet device integer

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Device returns a status of not connected or connected 0 | 1

params.name: Use host-target connection
params.values: Use Ethernet connection between development and target computers ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Remote server IP address
params.values: IP address of the server device x.x.x.x

params.name: Remote server port
params.values: Port number of the server device 1–65535

params.name: Use Nagle’s algorithm
params.values: Enable Nagle’s algorithm to combine packets on (default) | off

params.name: Client IP address
params.values: IP address of the client device that is being configured no value (default) | x.x.x.x

params.name: Client local port
params.values: IP port of the client device that is being configured no value (default) | 0–65535
